name: A01_1_a_flying_creature_spell_you_cast_costs_one_less_and_buffs_the_watcher
notes: Printed: 'Creature spells with flying you cast cost {1} less to cast.' and 'Whenever another creature you control with flying enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' Mistral Singer ({2}{U}, printed flying) is cast from the hand with the game's own payment (tapping lands): its {2}{U} costs {1}{U}, so exactly two Islands pay it and both are tapped. It enters, and the Watcher (2/2) becomes 3/3.
